on_screen_text.text: NBA players speak out on the murders of Alex Pretti and Renée Nicole Good
"Now more than ever, we must defend the right to freedom of speech and stand in solidarity with the people in Minnesota protesting and risking their lives to demand justice."

"What is happening in the Twin Cities and the Great North Star State is heartbreaking to witness. These events have cost lives and shaken families — and we must call for accountability, transparency, and protections for all people. This moment demands that we reflect honestly on what our values truly are. My thoughts, prayers, and deepest condolences are with the families of Renée Good and Alex Pretti. I stand with the people of Minnesota."
"As helpless as it may seem at times, there is impact in choosing that compassion within your immediate reach. It may feel small, but it is anything but insignificant."

LANDRY SHAMET
NEW YORK KNICKS GUARD
